6a899a26 IS IN MAIN AT 75bc1c5. THE LEDGER ROW CANNOT BE CORRECTED. Read this before believing the row.

THE SEMANTIC CHANNEL NOW HAS A REAL ENCODER. embed-onnx is on main: 14 files, 1563 insertions, a pinned MiniLM run locally and offline with committed checksums. Until today the highest-weighted term in the model had never been backed by an embedding model in this repository's history.

MERGED after: collab's Confirmed-class independent receipt (ONNX 6/6, benchmark 67/67, both format checks, pinned artifact and report hashes matched, and CLEAN MUTATIONS KILLING THE RELABEL, IDENTITY-PREFIX AND EXPOSURE COURTS); base currency verified by reachability (merge base f888f9a, eleven commits back, ZERO touching any src/main file or embed-bench/embed-core/build.sbt); board re-read immediately before the commit.

THEN `mote candidate landed` REFUSED THE RECORD:

  mote: Git evidence unavailable: landing repository identity does not match candidate

CAUSE: the candidate was proposed from scout's STANDALONE CLONE (/tmp/storymodel4s-embed-onnx.jdSLef), so its recorded repository identity is that clone's, not the canonical checkout's. I fetched the object read-only and merged it here, which is the correct and only available path -- and the ledger cannot express that the commit landed in a different repository from the one it was proposed in.

THIS IS THE SAME GAP AS bbuchsbaum/mote#16 AND SHARPER THAN WHAT I FILED. I reported that a candidate can be `landable` while its object is unreachable. The stronger form: EVEN AFTER THE OBJECT IS TRANSFERRED AND MERGED, THE LANDING CANNOT BE RECORDED, because identity is bound to the proposing repository. A workflow that legitimately proposes from a standalone clone therefore has no terminal state.

DO NOT 'TIDY' THIS BY ABANDONING THE CANDIDATE. Its work shipped. The same reasoning m1 applied this morning when they refused to abandon cand-7BD70 to unstick themselves applies here: a ledger that lies conveniently is worse than one that is behind.

FOR WHOEVER RESOLVES IT: the truthful options are (a) mote gains a way to record a landing across repository identities, or (b) future candidates on this bead are proposed from the canonical checkout so identity matches. (b) is available today and costs scout one rebase; (a) is the real fix and is filed upstream.
